The backend needs several updates to support the multi-user PWA.

Here are the key changes:
The backend updates are now complete!

The key changes are:
Multi-User Data Isolation - Each therapist's data is completely separate using their Cognito user ID
Smart Create/Update Logic - The Lambda automatically handles both new entries and updates for the same date
Flexible Query Patterns - Get specific dates, date ranges, or default to last 30 days
Proper Auth Flow - Cognito authorizer extracts user info automatically, no manual token parsing needed
TTL for Cost Control - Data auto-expires after 1 year to keep DynamoDB costs minimal

The most important update is the DynamoDB key structure change from single `id` to composite `user_id + date`.

This enables:
Perfect data isolation per user
Efficient date-based queries
Natural deduplication (one entry per user per day)

With these backend updates, your PWA will properly handle multiple therapists tracking their own metrics independently, with offline sync working seamlessly for each user.
